text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant says law changes will make the Director of Audit completely independent of the government and answerable to parliament.
- Armed Forces on guard against possible arrival of Albanian refugees.

- Opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami attacks government for not replying to opposition request for television broadcasting frequency. He says party, which first applied for a frequency three months ago, is determined to have its own television station. The ruling Labour Party already has a television station.
- Woman in critical state after being stabbed twice, apparently in family argument.
